mentions.description: This website hosts Anime character profiles styled like LinkedIn member profiles, with each profile linked to a specialized, highly precise AI that persists in its role. It includes Otaku AI, described as a true anime AI chat with no chat limits, plus an Anime suggestion engine for recommending anime.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on an Anime website, the idea is to create Anime character profiles like that of Linkedin members profiles. every profile will be linked to its specialized ad highly precise AI with persistency our its role. We will be bringing first ever true anime AI, know as Otaku AI to life with no chat limits along with an Anime suggestion engine.
